site.notes: Insect samples were collected from different parts of the bluff. The ages associated with a particular sample are based on the closest radiocarbon date.  Ages range from mid-Wisconsinan to late Holocene. The modern fauna is listed in Sample 16A. In addition to pollen, macroscopic plant remains are also known from the section.

site.sitedescription: A sequence of Pleistocene alluvium and Holocene thaw-lake sediments exposed in a natural riverbluff exposure on the eastern bank of the Titaluk River at the inner margin of the Arctic Coastal Plain.
